stages.name: Neural Network Foundations
stages.why: Every later stage reuses these layers, losses, and the gradient-checking habit.
stages.concepts: Array shapes, broadcasting, chain rule, softmax, cross-entropy, gradient descent

tasks.title: Set up the Python environment
tasks.done: Virtual env is active and python --version prints 3.10 or newer

tasks.title: Install NumPy, Matplotlib, Pytest
tasks.done: pip list shows all three and import numpy runs without error

tasks.title: Create the project folder and Git repo
tasks.done: Repo has src/, tests/, notebooks/ and a first commit

tasks.title: Understand NumPy arrays and dimensions
tasks.done: You predict the shape of 5 reshape and broadcast cases, then confirm each in code

tasks.title: Implement vector operations
tasks.done: Dot product, norm, and elementwise ops match np results

tasks.title: Implement matrix multiplication
tasks.done: Loop version equals a @ b on random 4x3 times 3x5 matrices

tasks.title: Implement activation functions
tasks.done: ReLU, tanh, sigmoid have forward and derivative; tests pass on known values

tasks.title: Implement softmax
tasks.done: Rows sum to 1 and inputs like 1000 give no NaN

tasks.title: Implement a loss function
tasks.done: MSE and cross-entropy return 0 for a perfect prediction and match a hand-computed value

tasks.title: Understand derivatives and gradients
tasks.done: You differentiate x squared, sigmoid, and a two-variable function on paper

tasks.title: Implement a forward pass
tasks.done: Two-layer network returns outputs of shape (batch, out)

tasks.title: Derive backpropagation on paper
tasks.done: One page deriving dW, db, dX for a linear layer

tasks.title: Implement backpropagation manually
tasks.done: Every gradient has the same shape as its parameter

tasks.title: Implement gradient descent
tasks.done: Loss falls steadily over 100 steps on toy data

tasks.title: Perform numerical gradient checking
tasks.done: Relative error is below 1e-5 for every parameter

tasks.title: Train, test, and document the two-layer network
tasks.done: XOR is solved, loss plot is saved, and results are logged in the journal

stages.name: Language Modeling Foundations
stages.why: Language models predict the next token, so data and batching must be right before any attention.
stages.concepts: Tokens, vocabulary, next-token prediction, train/validation split, embeddings, perplexity

tasks.title: Choose a small text corpus
tasks.done: A file under 1 MB loads and its first 200 characters print

tasks.title: Inspect corpus statistics
tasks.done: Character count, unique characters, and top 10 frequencies are printed

tasks.title: Build the character vocabulary
tasks.done: char-to-id and id-to-char maps exist and vocab size is printed

tasks.title: Write encode and decode
tasks.done: decode(encode(text)) equals text for the whole corpus

tasks.title: Convert the corpus to an integer array
tasks.done: Array is integer dtype and its length equals the character count

tasks.title: Split into train and validation
tasks.done: 90/10 split with no overlap and sizes printed

tasks.title: Create input-target pairs
tasks.done: y is x shifted by one token, checked on 3 samples

tasks.title: Build a batch sampler with context length
tasks.done: x and y both have shape (B, T)

tasks.title: Implement the embedding lookup
tasks.done: Output is (B, T, C) and backward adds gradients into the used rows only

tasks.title: Build a bigram language model
tasks.done: Forward returns logits (B, T, V) and a loss

tasks.title: Check the initial loss
tasks.done: Starting loss is close to ln(vocab size)

tasks.title: Write the training and validation loops
tasks.done: Both losses fall, the loss curve is saved, and sample text is generated

stages.name: Attention Mechanism
stages.why: Attention lets each token read from earlier tokens; it is the core of GPT.
stages.concepts: Queries, keys, values, scaled dot product, causal mask, multi-head attention

tasks.title: Understand queries, keys, and values
tasks.done: You explain Q, K, V in 3 sentences using a 3-token example

tasks.title: Implement Q, K, V projections
tasks.done: Each output has shape (B, T, head_dim)

tasks.title: Compute attention scores
tasks.done: Scores have shape (B, T, T) and equal Q times K transposed

tasks.title: Apply scaling
tasks.done: Score variance is near 1 with scaling and larger without it

tasks.title: Apply the causal mask
tasks.done: Upper triangle is set to negative infinity before softmax

tasks.title: Verify the mask blocks the future
tasks.done: Changing token t+1 leaves the output at t unchanged

tasks.title: Apply softmax to the scores
tasks.done: Rows sum to 1 and masked entries are exactly 0

tasks.title: Weight the values
tasks.done: Output equals weights times V with shape (B, T, head_dim)

tasks.title: Implement single-head backward
tasks.done: Gradient check relative error is below 1e-5

tasks.title: Implement multi-head split and merge
tasks.done: Splitting then merging returns the original tensor

tasks.title: Add the output projection
tasks.done: Shape returns to (B, T, C)

tasks.title: Test multi-head attention end to end
tasks.done: Pytest suite passes for shapes, mask, and gradient checks

stages.name: Transformer Architecture
stages.why: A block combines attention with feed-forward layers; stacking blocks gives depth.
stages.concepts: Positional encoding, layer normalization, residual connections, feed-forward networks, pre-norm

tasks.title: Implement token embeddings
tasks.done: Output shape is (B, T, C) and a shape test passes

tasks.title: Implement positional embeddings
tasks.done: Shape is (T, C) and different positions give different vectors

tasks.title: Combine token and positional embeddings
tasks.done: Sum has shape (B, T, C)

tasks.title: Implement the feed-forward network
tasks.done: Hidden layer is 4 times wider and output shape equals input shape

tasks.title: Implement the activation with its derivative
tasks.done: GELU or ReLU matches a numerical derivative

tasks.title: Implement layer norm forward
tasks.done: Each token has mean near 0 and standard deviation near 1

tasks.title: Implement layer norm backward
tasks.done: Gradient check error is below 1e-5

tasks.title: Add residual connections
tasks.done: Output is x plus f(x) and gradients flow through both paths

tasks.title: Choose pre-norm or post-norm
tasks.done: A short note in the journal explains your choice

tasks.title: Assemble the Transformer block
tasks.done: Output shape equals input shape

tasks.title: Implement backward through the block
tasks.done: Gradient check passes on the whole block

tasks.title: Write block unit tests
tasks.done: Pytest passes for shapes and gradients

stages.name: GPT Architecture
stages.why: This stage connects everything into one model that outputs next-token probabilities.
stages.concepts: Decoder-only models, logits, weight initialization, autoregressive generation, sampling

tasks.title: Define the config object
tasks.done: vocab size, context length, layers, heads, and embedding size live in one place

tasks.title: Initialize parameters randomly
tasks.done: Weights use small std (about 0.02) and all shapes are printed

tasks.title: Stack N Transformer blocks
tasks.done: Changing the layer count in config changes the model depth

tasks.title: Add the final layer norm
tasks.done: Output shape is still (B, T, C)

tasks.title: Add the language-modeling head
tasks.done: Logits have shape (B, T, V)

tasks.title: Compute cross-entropy over all positions
tasks.done: Loss is a single finite number

tasks.title: Check the initial loss
tasks.done: Starting loss is close to ln(vocab size)

tasks.title: Implement the full backward pass
tasks.done: Gradient check passes on a tiny model (2 layers, embedding size 8)

tasks.title: Implement the generation loop
tasks.done: Requested number of tokens is produced

tasks.title: Add temperature and top-k sampling
tasks.done: Top-k 1 is greedy and low temperature is near deterministic

tasks.title: Generate from the untrained model
tasks.done: Gibberish output is saved as your baseline

stages.name: Training GPT from Scratch
stages.why: Training turns random weights into a working model; stable loops matter more than size.
stages.concepts: Adam, learning-rate schedule, gradient clipping, overfitting, checkpoints

tasks.title: Choose the final dataset
tasks.done: Corpus is CPU-sized (a few MB at most) and loads cleanly

tasks.title: Build the data pipeline
tasks.done: Train and validation batches load with the correct shapes

tasks.title: Pick a CPU-friendly config
tasks.done: Model has under 1M parameters and step time is measured

tasks.title: Implement Adam with weight decay
tasks.done: One update matches a hand-computed step

tasks.title: Add gradient clipping
tasks.done: Gradient norm never exceeds your chosen limit

tasks.title: Add learning-rate warmup and decay
tasks.done: Schedule plot is saved

tasks.title: Overfit a single batch
tasks.done: Loss on one batch drops close to 0

tasks.title: Launch the full training run
tasks.done: Training loss decreases steadily

tasks.title: Log losses every N steps
tasks.done: Train and validation loss are saved to a CSV or log file

tasks.title: Save checkpoints
tasks.done: A .npz file with all parameters is written

tasks.title: Resume from a checkpoint
tasks.done: Loss continues from where it stopped instead of resetting

tasks.title: Generate samples at several checkpoints
tasks.done: Samples show visible improvement and are saved

tasks.title: Document the run
tasks.done: Config, time taken, final losses, and observations are in the journal

stages.name: Evaluation and Experiments
stages.why: Measurements show what actually helps on a CPU budget.
stages.concepts: Perplexity, parameter counting, scaling, controlled experiments, memory profiling

tasks.title: Count parameters per component
tasks.done: A table lists embeddings, attention, feed-forward, and total

tasks.title: Estimate model size
tasks.done: Size in MB is reported and matches the checkpoint file

tasks.title: Compute validation loss
tasks.done: Loss is measured on the full validation set

tasks.title: Compute perplexity
tasks.done: Perplexity equals exp(validation loss) and is recorded

tasks.title: Measure training time per step
tasks.done: Average step time over 50 steps is recorded

tasks.title: Measure peak memory
tasks.done: Peak RAM is recorded for one run

tasks.title: Experiment with depth
tasks.done: Runs with 1, 2, and 4 layers are compared

tasks.title: Experiment with embedding size
tasks.done: At least 3 sizes are compared with the same data and steps

tasks.title: Experiment with context length
tasks.done: At least 3 lengths are compared

tasks.title: Plot the results
tasks.done: Plots of loss vs size and time vs size are saved

tasks.title: Analyze the generated text
tasks.done: Notes cover repetition, spelling, and structure

tasks.title: Document limitations and findings
tasks.done: A written summary lists limits and what you would try next

tasks.title: Implement BPE training

tasks.title: Implement BPE encode and decode

tasks.title: Train the GPT with the subword tokenizer

tasks.title: Collect a Bengali dataset
